executive_summary: Overweight AFRM with staged accumulation rather than a full-size immediate entry, given strong fundamental improvement but an extended, high-volatility setup. Start modestly above benchmark or normal risk, roughly 3% to 5% initial exposure, and add on pullbacks toward major moving-average support instead of chasing single-day strength. Use tighter risk controls than a typical growth position, especially if credit metrics, provisioning trends, or funding access worsen. Time horizon is intermediate, with reassessment if Google and merchant distribution wins fail to convert into sustained GMV, margin, and earnings progression.
